summary: Implement the accepted canonical semantic lifecycle without changing intent or frozen tests. Canonical argo init privately composes preserved WP-P1 full reconciliation and WP-P2 readiness under exactly ARGO_LIVE_PROVIDER_E2E plus ARGO_W31_LIVE_MUTATION_VECTOR_E2E (no third flag); successful batch/focused writes use readiness-first exact-touched durable upsert/tombstone; every ordinary getSystemArchitecture query freshly verifies persistent readiness; getSystemArchitecture is the sole public read/query semantic surface. Credentials remain external-only, WP-P1/WP-P2 remain private, WP-P3 public exposure is retired, production runId cleanup is prohibited while existing cleanup remains test-only, deliveryStatus is runner-owned, and code-complete evidence remains distinct from live-release evidence. Pre-coding runner baseline: 43 total, 34 passed, 9 scoped failures, 0 missing criteria, and 0 out-of-scope failures; failure records are design/KG/test-failure-records.json.
